probe-isolation.legacy_risk_reason: Coverage is unmeasured in this repository and no line-coverage percentage is recorded; legacy-safe TDD is required. The change additionally touches a hand-maintained sibling-flat copy with no emitter and no drift check, so the blast radius of the translation is reviewed expressly rather than measured. The packaged copy's isolation posture is asserted by a mandatory structural drift guard (AC-14) rather than by a build step, because no emitter renders it.
